1.consolidated_definition: Aspecto, apariencia. Imagen de las personas o las cosas vistas en su aspecto exterior. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Por otro lado, aquellas extensiones sintéticas y baratas pueden dar un look tan artificial como el de Barbie (Primera Hora, 11-10-05)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Aspecto, appearance. Image of people or things as seen in their external aspect. Raw Anglicism, commonly used. On the other hand, those synthetic and cheap extensions can give a look as artificial as Barbie's (First Hour, 11-10-05)
